cohort: The study included 239 pregnant women aged 20-35 years with singleton pregnancies, recruited at 14-18 weeks gestational age, excluding those with medical conditions or medications that could alter serum lipid levels.
finding: There was no significant association between maternal hyperlipidemia, or individual serum lipid values determined early in pregnancy, and spontaneous preterm delivery or gestational age at delivery.
gest_age: Participants were recruited at 14-18 weeks gestational age, and outcomes related to delivery before 37 weeks were assessed.
